# Humanizer source

Vendored from https://github.com/blader/humanizer at commit
`9862685f575c65a8247f90369951df1b3416e3d6` (version 3.0.0).
`SKILL.md` is unchanged. The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

JTA embeds this skill in its recommendation prompt. Embedded mode applies to
prose fields only; the review schema, grounding checks, exact quotes, paths,
numbers, and literal edit contents take precedence. No extra rewriting call or
runtime download is needed. This is writing guidance, not an AI detector.
